:::: {.hero}
# Moving Together

::: {.stand}
This is a three-day movement retreat for anyone. It brings together yoga,
tantra and improvised movement, practised alone, in pairs and as a whole group.
:::
::::

::: {.band .band-moving}
:::

What happens when a room full of people stops moving the way they think they
should, and starts moving the way they actually feel? Some sessions will start
from breath and awareness. Others will open space for play and creative
expression, where you follow, lead, mirror and respond to the people around you,
and find out what a group can do that no one can do alone.

Over the three days, there will be time to notice old habits, and to widen your
attention from your own body to the group. No experience is needed, and there is
no right way to do any of it.

We will share the group agreements before you book. Throughout, you are free to
take part at your own pace — to sit out, or to watch.

:::: {.about}

::: {.ab}
[Who it is for]{.k}

Anyone curious about movement, connection and creativity, whether you have
practised for years or are just beginning. Adults (18+).
:::

::: {.ab}
[When]{.k}

Tentatively September 2027. Three days.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Where]{.k}

Germany.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Touch]{.k}

Some exercises will involve touch between participants, such as a hand on the back
or leaning into each other's weight. Touch is always optional: you can say no,
or change your mind, at any time without giving a reason, and there is always a
way to take part without it. Nothing in the retreat is sexual, and everyone
stays clothed.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Included]{.k}

Accommodation and food.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Language]{.k}

English. Everyday English is enough.
:::

::::

::: {.empty}
Venue, exact dates and price to follow.

::: {.empty}
This retreat is not therapy or medical treatment. If you have a physical or
mental health condition, please tell us before booking, so we can talk it
through together.
